text: In XXXX of XXXX, I reached out to the Flagship Credit Acceptance regarding lowering my monthly payment. I spoke to a supervisor who informed me that my payment would change from {$1000.00} to {$900.00} and I will be notified in writing of the changes. I have yet to receive any new paperwork reflecting the change. The company also assured me that my late payments from ( XXXX XXXX, XX/XX/XXXX, and XX/XX/XXXX ) would be removed as well. My credit report has not been updated from Flagship Credit Acceptance since XX/XX/XXXX. This oversight has hindered my homebuying process and I would like it updated and corrected immediately.
